cases.sentence: – А, как это мило! – сказала она, подавая руку мужу и улыбкой здороваясь с ___, Слюдиным. – Ты ночуешь, надеюсь? – было первое слово, которое подсказал ей дух обмана, – а теперь едем вместе.
cases.explain: «домашним человеком» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Ah, how nice of you!” she said, giving her husband her hand, and greeting Sludin, who was like one of the family, with a smile. “You’re staying the night, I hope?” was the first word the spirit of falsehood prompted her to utter; “and now we’ll go together. Only it’s a pity I’ve promised Betsy. She’s coming for me.”

cases.sentence: – О, я не стану разлучать неразлучных, – сказал он своим ___ шутки. – Мы поедем с Михайлом Васильевичем.
cases.explain: «обычным тоном» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Oh, I’m not going to separate the inseparables,” he said in his usual bantering tone. “I’m going with Mihail Vassilievitch. I’m ordered exercise by the doctors too. I’ll walk, and fancy myself at the springs again.”

cases.sentence: Она сама чувствовала это, тем более что в ___, которым взглянул на нее Михаил Васильевич, она заметила, что он как будто наблюдал ее.
cases.explain: «любопытном взгляде» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: She spoke very simply and naturally, but too much and too fast. She was the more aware of this from noticing in the inquisitive look Mihail Vassilievitch turned on her that he was, as it were, keeping watch on her.

cases.sentence: – У тебя не совсем ___, – сказала она.
cases.explain: «хороший вид» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “You don’t look quite well,” she said.

cases.sentence: Все это она говорила весело, быстро и с ___ в глазах; но Алексей Александрович теперь не приписывал этому тону ее никакого значения.
cases.explain: «особенным блеском» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: All this she said brightly, rapidly, and with a peculiar brilliance in her eyes. But Alexey Alexandrovitch did not now attach any special significance to this tone of hers. He heard only her words and gave them only the direct sense they bore. And he answered simply, though jestingly. There was nothing remarkable in all this conversation, but never after could Anna recall this brief scene without an agonizing pang of shame.
